e.title: **一份**把「**保险经纪公司**的**AI 操作系统**」**写到**逐模块**与**逐状态**的**重建中仓库****：`autobrokers-intelligence-os`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**；**⭐ 重建公式逐字为**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**；**⭐ 而**其**「**当前状态**」**逐字列出**已完成 14 项**（**Web **Next.js、**API **FastAPI、**Supabase／**Redis／**Qdrant／**MinIO 均已配置**）**与**未完成 13 项**（**含逐字**「**integração real com seguradoras**」**与**「**produção**」**）**；**⭐ 三条运行时纪律逐字为**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**；**⭐ 仓库树实测 **2,365 个文件**（**852 个 **`.py`**、**569 个 **`.ts`／**`.tsx`**、**520 个 **`.md`**、**127 个 **`.sql`**、**124 个 **`.jsonl`****）**
e.title_en: A mid-rebuild repository that documents an insurance broker artificial-intelligence operating system down to each module and each state: it describes itself in writing as a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers, states its rebuild formula as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, lists fourteen things that already work, from the web client and the interface service to the configured support services, alongside thirteen that do not, including real insurer integration and production, adopts three runtime rules stating that one legacy system is a reference rather than a runtime, that another is a domain source rather than an active runtime, and that raw intake is sensitive and blocked from direct use, and ships a tree of more than two thousand files dominated by Python, TypeScript, documentation, SQL, and structured log lines.

e.summary_en: This is a repository for a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform aimed at insurance brokerages, describing itself in writing as a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers. **Measured this round**: created in early June and last pushed on the tenth of September, a repository of about thirty-two megabytes whose main language is Python, no licence file, no stars, a description of about twenty-five kilobytes over one thousand four hundred thirty-eight lines in Portuguese, and a tree of two thousand three hundred sixty-five files including eight hundred fifty-two Python files, five hundred sixty-nine TypeScript files, five hundred twenty documents, one hundred twenty-seven SQL files, and one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language and was reached through the Portuguese word for insurance brokerage.** **Four things are worth reading: the current-state section is split in writing into fourteen things that already work and thirteen that do not, the latter including real integration with insurers and production deployment; three runtime rules state plainly what is a reference, what is current, and what is blocked; the rebuild formula is written as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, so an older system is decomposed into parts and reassembled rather than thrown away; and the mix of five hundred twenty documents with one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files shows a repository that is simultaneously a documentation set and a store of structured records.** **The system was not run this round and no claim is made that any of its services actually works.**
e.body:
**AutoBrokers Intelligence OS**（`Amandico100/AutoBrokers-Intelligence-OS`）**是一份**面向**保险经纪公司**的**多租户 **AI 平台**仓库****——**逐字自述为**「**a fundação técnica, operacional e estratégica do AutoBrokers.ai, uma plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**当前状态**」**被**逐项**分成**能跑**与**不能跑**两栏****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**十四项**已完成**：**沙箱已装、**使用 **EasyPanel、**Web **Next.js** 可用、**API **FastAPI** 可用、**Supabase 沙箱已配置、**Redis、**Qdrant、**MinIO 均已配置、**后台可访问、**租户登录可用、**租户聊天可用、**AutoBrokers 在沙箱中可回应、**规范文档在 **`docs/canon/`**、**历史文档已移入 **`docs/_archive/`****；**⭐ 并逐字列出**十三项**尚未完成**：**最终设计系统、**最终 **UX、**最终侧边栏、**Auxiliares 模块、**完整 **Vault、**有安全策展的 **RAG、**在新运行时中重建的 **Atendimento、**已移植的 **corredores、**真实 **WhatsApp、**真实 **InfoCap／**Quiver、**Docling／**worker 的最终流程、**⭐ **与保险公司的真实对接**（**逐字**：**integração real com seguradoras**）**、**⭐ **生产环境**（**逐字**：**produção**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这两栏**是**本轮**最值得**单独**记下的**一处**：**⭐ 即**一份**AI 产品**的**真实进度**，**可以**用**「**能跑／**不能跑**」**两栏**说清**——**⭐ 而**其中**最**关键的**两条**（**与**保险公司**对接、**上生产**）**都**还在**未完成**栏里**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**演示**与**落地**之间**，**通常**差的**正是**这两条**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三条**运行时纪律**把**参考物**、**现行物**与**封禁物**分开****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**、**并**逐字规定**「**/dashboard deve permanecer chat-first**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**纪律**解决**的**是**重建期**特有的**混乱**：**⭐ 即**当**一个产品**有**三代**实现**并存**时**，**「**哪个**还算数**」**必须**写下来**——**⭐ 否则**代理（**人或 **AI）**会**照着**旧实现**改**新代码**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 重建公式与**三种智能**的分层****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**公式**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**，**并逐字说明**产品层**管**品牌、**体验、**导航、**模块与**最终语言**；**⭐ 另逐字区分**三类智能**（**AutoBrokers 本体、**服务代理、**辅助模块）**与**七个主模块**（**含 **Conectores（**连接器）**、**Conhecimento（**知识）**、**Admin Global**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**把**「**领域大脑**」**单独**命名**，**是**承认**领域知识**与**运行时**可以**分开演进**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**要**做**保险 **AI 产品**，**把**知识层**（**条款、**费率、**流程）**与**编排层**分开**，**将来**换**模型**或**换**框架**时**代价**最小**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库构成**说明**它**同时**是**文档库**与**数据／轨迹库****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**仓库树 **2,365 个文件**、**合计约 **43,109 KB****（**⭐ 而**接口 **`size` 字段为 **32,880 KB**）**，**逐个扩展名**为 **`.py` 852**、**`.md` 520**、**`.ts` 313**、**`.tsx` 256**、**`.sql` 127**、**`.jsonl` 124**、**`.html` 27**、**`.json` 25**、**`.csv` 7**、**`.patch` 7**、**`.xlsx` 2** 等**；**顶层目录逐字**含 **`.agents`、**`.github`、**`app`、**`backend`、**`components`、**`docling-service`、**`docs`、**`hooks`、**`infra`、**`lib`、**`public`、**`scripts`、**`supabase`、**`types`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即 **520 个 Markdown** 与 **一个 **`.agents`** 目录**，**说明**这**是**一个**由 **AI 代理**参与**维护的**文档密集**仓库**——**⭐ 而**其中**哪些**是**规范**、**哪些**是**历史**，**由**其**逐字指定的 **`docs/canon/`** 与 **`docs/_archive/`** 两个目录**来**区分**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurancepro-crm]]、**[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 与**[[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**代理与**经纪的**业务平台**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**多租户 **AI 平台**形态**重建**经纪公司**作业系统**」这一形态**，**并且**把**重建进度**写成**可核对**的**两栏**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **用**「**能跑／**不能跑**」**两栏**替代**含糊的**进度描述**；**② **重建期**要**写清**哪个**实现**还算数**；**③ **知识层**与**编排层**分开**命名**；**④ **把**「**与**保险公司**对接**」**与**「**上生产**」**单独**列为**里程碑**；**⑤ **规范文档**与**历史文档**分目录**；**⑥ **原始**输入（**intake）**若**敏感**，**默认**封禁**直接使用**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**该系统**（**未安装依赖、**未起任何服务、**未连接 **Supabase／**Redis／**Qdrant／**MinIO**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何服务**可用**、**也不主张**其**自述的**已完成项**在**我**环境**中**成立**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**README 全文**与**仓库树**（**文件名与**字节数**）**，**未读**其 **Python／**TypeScript** 源码**、**未读**其 **520 个 Markdown** 中的**任何一篇**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**——**⭐ 且**它**逐字**含**「**Termos proibidos como marca visível**」（**禁止作为可见品牌的术语）**一节**，**说明**其**品牌与**使用边界**有**自定规则**，**⚠️ 本词条**不**替代**其**许可判断**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**与**任何**保险公司**或**经纪公司**有**真实**业务关系**（**⭐ 其**自述**明确说**「**与**保险公司的真实对接**」**尚未完成）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**以**真实客户数据**运行**（**⭐ 逐字只说**沙箱与**租户登录**可用**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ README **含**产品与**商业定位**表述**，**⚠️ 本词条**只转述**可核实**的**状态**与**结构**，**不**对其**商业前景**作**评述**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该仓库**是**平台工程**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**承保或**投资意见**。

e.body_hk:
**AutoBrokers Intelligence OS**（`Amandico100/AutoBrokers-Intelligence-OS`）**是一份**面向**保險經紀公司**的**多租戶 AI 平台**倉庫****——**逐字自述為**「**uma plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de inteligência artificial para corretoras de seguros**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「當前狀態」被逐項分成能跑與不能跑兩欄****——**已完成十四項逐字含**沙箱已裝、**EasyPanel、**Web Next.js 可用、**API FastAPI 可用、**Supabase／Redis／Qdrant／MinIO 已配置、**後台可訪問、**租戶登錄與**租戶聊天可用、**AutoBrokers 在沙箱中可回應、**規範文檔在 `docs/canon/`、**歷史文檔在 `docs/_archive/`**；**未完成十三項逐字含**最終設計系統、**最終 UX、**側邊欄、**Auxiliares 模組、**完整 Vault、**有安全策展的 RAG、**重建的 Atendimento、**已移植的 corredores、**真實 WhatsApp、**真實 InfoCap／Quiver、**Docling／worker 最終流程、**⭐**integração real com seguradoras**、**⭐**produção****；**⭐ 即**最關鍵的兩條**（**與保險公司對接、**上生產**）**都還在未完成欄**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三條運行時紀律****——**逐字**「**ResultVision é referência, não runtime**」**、**「**Agent OS é fonte de domínio, não runtime ativo**」**、**「**intake bruto é sensível e bloqueado para uso direto**」**、**並規定**「**/dashboard deve permanecer chat-first**」**；**⭐ 即**重建期**必須寫清**哪個實現還算數**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 重建公式與分層****——**逐字**「**AutoBrokers.ai = Product Layer + Smith Runtime Engine + AutoBrokers Domain Brain**」**；**另逐字區分**三類智能與**七個主模組**（**含 Conectores、**Conhecimento、**Admin Global**）**；**⭐ 即**把領域大腦單獨命名**，**承認**知識層與**運行時**可分開演進**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 倉庫構成****——**2,365 個檔案**、**約 43,109 KB**（**介面 size 欄位為 32,880 KB**）**，**逐擴展名**為 `.py` 852、`.md` 520、`.ts` 313、`.tsx` 256、`.sql` 127、`.jsonl` 124** 等**；**頂層目錄逐字含** `.agents`、`.github`、`app`、`backend`、`components`、`docling-service`、`docs`、`hooks`、`infra`、`lib`、`public`、`scripts`、`supabase`、`types`**；**⭐ 即**規範與歷史**由 **`docs/canon/`** 與 **`docs/_archive/`** 區分**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurancepro-crm]]、[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以多租戶 AI 平台形態重建經紀公司作業系統**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **用「**能跑／**不能跑**」兩欄替代含糊進度**；**② **重建期寫清哪個實現還算數**；**③ **知識層與編排層分開命名**；**④ **把「**與保險公司對接**」與「**上生產**」單列為里程碑**；**⑤ **規範與歷史文檔分目錄**；**⑥ **敏感原始輸入默認封禁直接用**。

This is a repository for a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform aimed at insurance brokerages, describing itself in writing as the technical, operational, and strategic foundation of a multi-tenant software-as-a-service artificial-intelligence platform for insurance brokers. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the current-state section is split item by item into what runs and what does not.** Fourteen finished items are listed in writing: the sandbox is installed, a panel tool is in use, the web client works, the interface service works, and the sandbox database, cache, vector store, and object store are configured, with the administration area reachable, tenant login and tenant chat working, the assistant responding inside the sandbox, canonical documents under one directory and historical documents moved to an archive directory. **Thirteen unfinished items are listed beside them**, including the final design system, the final user experience, the final sidebar, one module as a finished product, a complete secrets vault, retrieval with safe curation, a rebuilt service desk, ported broker components, real messaging integration, two real external systems, a definitive document-processing flow, **real integration with insurers**, and **production**. **Being able to say plainly which parts run and which do not is the most valuable thing to copy here, and in this case the two most consequential items, real insurer integration and production, both sit in the unfinished column, which is usually exactly the gap between a demonstration and a deployment.**

**Second, three runtime rules separate what is a reference, what is current, and what is blocked.** The description states in writing that one legacy system is a reference rather than a runtime, that another is a domain source rather than an active runtime, and that raw intake is sensitive and blocked from direct use, and it also fixes a product rule that one dashboard must remain conversation-first. **This set of rules addresses the specific confusion of a rebuild period, because when three generations of an implementation coexist, which one still counts has to be written down, or both human and machine contributors will modify new code according to an obsolete design.**

**Third, the rebuild formula and the layering are stated.** The description gives the formula as a product layer plus a runtime engine plus a domain brain, explains that the product layer owns brand, experience, navigation, modules, and final language, distinguishes three classes of intelligence, and names seven main modules including connectors, knowledge, and global administration. **Naming the domain brain separately acknowledges that domain knowledge and runtime can evolve apart, and for anyone building an insurance product it is the cheapest future-proofing available, because it is what lets the model or the orchestration framework be replaced later.**

**Fourth, the repository composition shows it is simultaneously a documentation store and a record store.** The tree holds more than two thousand three hundred files totalling about forty-three megabytes, while the interface size field reports just under thirty-three megabytes, and the extension breakdown is dominated by eight hundred fifty-two Python files, five hundred twenty documents, five hundred sixty-nine TypeScript files, one hundred twenty-seven SQL files, one hundred twenty-four line-delimited data files, and a handful of spreadsheets and patches. **The presence of more than five hundred documents and an agent configuration directory indicates a documentation-dense repository maintained with machine assistance, and which documents are normative and which are historical is settled by the two directories the description names for exactly that purpose.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agency and brokerage business platforms, **while this entry supplies the form of rebuilding a brokerage operating system as a multi-tenant artificial-intelligence platform and writes the rebuild progress as a checkable pair of columns. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: replace vague progress language with a runs and does-not-run pair of columns; state which implementation still counts during a rebuild; name the knowledge layer separately from the orchestration layer; list real integration and production as their own milestones; keep normative and historical documentation in separate directories; and block sensitive raw intake by default.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the system was not run**, no dependencies were installed, no service was started, and none of the named support services was connected, **so no claim is made that any service works or that the stated finished items hold in this environment**. **Second, only metadata, the description in full, and the file tree with names and sizes were read**, not the source code and not any of the five hundred documents. **Third, the repository carries no licence file and includes a section listing terms prohibited as visible brands, so this entry does not substitute for its licensing position. Fourth, whether it has any real business relationship with an insurer or brokerage was not verified**, its own description stating that real insurer integration is unfinished. **Fifth, whether it runs on real customer data was not verified**, the stated status mentioning only a sandbox and tenant login. **Sixth, the description contains product and commercial positioning, and this entry transcribes only the checkable status and structure without commenting on commercial prospects. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the repository is platform engineering rather than an insurance product or an underwriting or investment opinion.**
